name: Visualizer
author: Andre Avila
description: Audio spectrum in the bar, in four combinable style axes and nine palettes, with the same colours mirrored on your WLED lights.

barWidget.description: The sound, in the bar. Pauses itself when nothing is playing and when you are on battery.

schema.label: Language
schema.description: auto follows the session locale; en and pt force one.

schema.label: Bar base
schema.description: Where a bar grows from.

schema.label: Bar cap
schema.description: What the end of a bar looks like.

schema.label: Bar fill
schema.description: solid is one colour; barGradient ramps each bar through the palette; screenGradient anchors one ramp to the drawing area.

schema.label: Palette
schema.description: accent, foreground, intensity and urgent follow the theme; spectrum, rainbow and heat sweep; gradient and solid use colours you pick.

schema.label: Audio input
schema.description: system taps the speakers, mic the microphone, both builds a virtual mix device and tears it down on exit.

schema.label: Microphone
schema.description: Which microphone the mic and both inputs listen to. Empty follows the system default, which is not always one with signal on it: a bluetooth headset in A2DP offers an input that is silence. Named by the short part of the device name.

schema.label: Peak markers
schema.description: A line left at each bar high-water mark.

schema.label: Wave
schema.description: An oscilloscope line under the bars. The only option that costs a canvas.

schema.label: Radial spread
schema.description: How much of the circle a radial base uses, 0..1.

schema.label: Radial inner radius
schema.description: Hole in the middle of a radial base, 0..1.

schema.label: Peak fall
schema.description: How fast a peak marker sinks back, in units per frame.

schema.label: Solid colour
schema.description: Hex, for the solid palette. Empty follows the theme accent.

schema.label: Gradient from
schema.description: Hex, for the gradient palette. Empty follows the theme.

schema.label: Gradient to
schema.description: Hex, for the gradient palette. Empty follows the theme.

schema.label: Urgent threshold
schema.description: Level at which the urgent palette turns, 50..100.

schema.label: Bars
schema.description: How many bands cava reports, 6..24.

schema.label: Segments
schema.description: Blocks per bar when the cap is segments.

schema.label: Frames per second
schema.description: 10..60. Lower is cheaper.

schema.label: Widget width
schema.description: Width of the spectrum in the bar, in pixels.

schema.label: Bar width
schema.description: Preferred bar width in the bar widget, in pixels.

schema.label: Fall
schema.description: How slowly a bar drops, 0..95.

schema.label: Floor
schema.description: Levels below this read as silence, 0..20.

schema.label: Pause when silent
schema.description: Stop cava when nothing is playing.

schema.label: Pause on battery
schema.description: Stop cava on battery power.

schema.label: WLED bridge
schema.description: Mirror the spectrum onto WLED lights.

schema.label: WLED mode
schema.description: spectrum, mirror, solid, params to move the light's own effect sliders, or bars for a matrix panel.

schema.label: WLED driven knob
schema.description: Which slider of the light's own effect the spectrum moves, by the name the light gives it. Empty picks automatically.

schema.label: WLED knob swing
schema.description: How far params mode may move a slider from the light's own setting, in percent. 0..100.

schema.label: WLED devices
schema.description: Comma-separated hosts or addresses.

schema.label: Restore WLED on exit
schema.description: Put the lights back the way they were.
